title: A Rainy Saturday at the Bookstore
passage:
Last Saturday, it was raining heavily in the morning, so Mia decided to visit the new bookstore near her apartment instead of going to the park.

While she was walking down the street, she saw her classmate Tony standing under the bookstore's blue sign. "What are you doing here?" Mia asked with a smile. Tony said he came to buy a dictionary to prepare for the English contest next month.

Inside the bookstore, the shelves were full of novels, comic books, and magazines. A friendly clerk greeted them and recommended a popular mystery novel. "This story is exciting enough to keep you reading all night," she said. Mia was curious about the ending, so she picked up a copy right away.

Tony looked carefully through several dictionaries before choosing the thickest one. "I need this dictionary to look up difficult words quickly," he explained. While Tony was paying for his dictionary, Mia noticed a small coffee corner in the back of the store, and they decided to sit there and chat about their weekend plans.

By the time they left the bookstore, the rain had already stopped, and the sky was turning bright again. "This was actually a better afternoon than I expected," Tony said happily. Mia agreed and promised to lend him the mystery novel once she finished it. They walked home together, feeling glad that the rainy morning had turned into such an enjoyable day.

grammar: while + 過去進行式 搭配過去簡單式：表示「當...的時候，另一件事發生了」，如 While she was walking down the street, she saw her classmate. / While Tony was paying for his dictionary, Mia noticed a coffee corner.
形容詞/副詞 + enough + to V：表示「足夠...以至於能夠...」，如 This story is exciting enough to keep you reading all night.
by the time + 子句，主要子句用過去完成時 (had + 過去分詞)：表示「在某個過去時間點之前已經發生的事」，如 By the time they left the bookstore, the rain had already stopped.

reading.q: Why did Mia decide to go to the bookstore instead of the park?
opts: The bookstore was having a sale
She needed to return a book
reading.ex: 文中提到 "it was raining heavily in the morning, so Mia decided to visit the new bookstore... instead of going to the park."

reading.q: What did Tony want to buy at the bookstore?
reading.ex: 文中寫道 "Tony said he came to buy a dictionary to prepare for the English contest."

reading.q: What did the clerk recommend to Mia?
reading.ex: 文中提到 clerk 推薦了一本 popular mystery novel。

reading.q: Why did Tony choose the thickest dictionary?
opts: He could look up difficult words quickly
reading.ex: Tony 解釋說 "I need this dictionary to look up difficult words quickly."

reading.q: What did Mia promise to do?
opts: Go with Tony to the contest
reading.ex: 文末提到 Mia promised to lend him the mystery novel once she finished it。

grammar.q: While Tony ___ for his dictionary, Mia noticed a coffee corner.
grammar.ex: while + 過去進行式表示「正在進行某動作時」，另一件事發生，故用 was paying。

grammar.q: This story is exciting ___ keep you reading all night.
grammar.ex: 「形容詞 + enough + to V」表示「足夠...以至於能夠」。

grammar.q: By the time they left the bookstore, the rain ___ already.
grammar.ex: by the time + 過去式子句，主要子句用過去完成時 (had + 過去分詞) 表示在那之前已完成的動作。

grammar.q: She ___ a book quietly when her friend called her name.
grammar.ex: 過去進行式表示過去某時間點正在進行的動作，常與表示突然發生的事件連用。

grammar.q: The box was heavy ___ for him to carry alone.
grammar.ex: 「too + 形容詞 + to V」表示「太...而不能」。

vocab.q: Which word means "a person who works in a store and helps customers"?
vocab.ex: clerk 意思是「店員」，在店裡協助顧客的人。

vocab.q: The word "mystery" in the passage best describes a story that is ___.
vocab.ex: mystery 意思是「懸疑、充滿謎團的」，常指令人好奇想解開謎底的故事。

vocab.q: "I was very ___ about the strange noise, so I went to check it."
vocab.ex: curious 意思是「好奇的」，符合句意「因為好奇而去查看」。

vocab.q: The word "promise" is closest in meaning to ___.
opts: to agree to do something for sure
vocab.ex: promise 意思是「承諾」，表示保證一定會做某件事。
thick 意思是「厚的」，與 thin（薄的）相反。
